$comment: Stratum B — the G4 projection config for apis.markets over the capital-markets substrate (template spec §2, docs/plans/2026-08-23-property-template-spec.md in the studio repo). Content, not code: one projection = one config file. Register context: thinnest row in cluster 3 — four names held (apis.markets primary; apis.trading/apis.investments/apis.broker are sub-audience rails WITHIN this property per the property-grain ruling, not separate brands), zero records ruled, source route not ruled. Scope, permanent: execution and custody out of scope — reference/market/position data and post-trade documents only.

subAudienceRails.status: content within this property (property-grain ruling); none serves today, so none is linked anywhere (presence-when-true)

icp.companyType: broker-dealers, RIAs, fund administrators, family offices

personas.description: an agent pulling reference, market, and position records — a data puller, never a trader
an agent reconciling positions against post-trade documents
an operations or middle-office systems owner reading the same records in a browser

offer.gate: none — keyless (AXP Clause 7, the universal floor)

pricing.note: rates[] rides TOP-LEVEL in the served Pricing Document (ruled bridge placement, batch-2 rollup) with every row priced from zero; the 402 door at /offer is a labeled stub, never fake billing

positioningNote: No positioning claim is carried. The agent-default claim is withheld until the §4.6 worthiness bar is attested (conformance verdict + live anon sandbox + verified published suite). No ranking is implied anywhere on this surface [CONVICTION]. Execution/custody exclusion is a scope statement, not a positioning claim.

experiment.hypothesis: none at wave zero — registration per template §7.3 (motion + pattern declared, trivially the freemium floor); the substrate rollup key is capital-markets

counterpartBrand.note: The row's ICP includes principals (family offices; RIA principals) who may transact through agents without API vocabulary — a B2A2B posture is plausible later. No held name qualifies as the human-vocabulary counterpart (apis.trading/investments/broker are all API-vocabulary rails), so the counterpart-brand gap is recorded per §5.1/§9.3; the trigger is the agent-referred-human diagnostic reading the signup/traffic seams, and the response is a register-row proposal named per #3 — never API-vocabulary patches on this surface.

b2aLadder.rung0: anon sandbox — live (the keyless collection over the labeled seed); the ONLY rung mounted and the only rung advertised
b2aLadder.rung1: earned credits — deferred (no .ax-ledger integration at wave zero)
b2aLadder.rung3: paid (402 metering on machine identity) — deferred; /offer is a labeled stub until then

coordination.axApiFinance: ~/projects/ax/packages/api.finance is the ADR-0020 markets-data + advisory possibility surface (Directory archetype: one typed Definition + classified capability collection, open-floor/BYOL/credential-reserved axes, no worker). apis.markets does NOT duplicate its directory ply — this property serves typed records, not a capability directory. A future EDGAR/FINRA-class ingest (the row's [UNVERIFIED] source route) coordinates with api.finance's open-floor classification before any real-corpus record is served.
